I will plant the rice the way I can manage with the cash I have, not the way people talk about when money is plenty. Last season I used only a little fertilizer, and this season I will still use some because I have seen farmers nearby get better paddy when they put fertilizer on good seed, but I will keep it low. I own this plot, so I do put manure when I can, and I will use improved seed again if I find the same one at the shop in time. I do not have irrigation here, so I will depend on the rains, and I will mostly use family work and only hire a few days when the work is heavy.
